svg.title: GrimGlow Issue 6 — Page 21 — "The Fog Looks Back" — Section 5 closes
svg.desc: Page 21: 4 panels in 3 tiers (full / half-half / full). Section 5 closes. Theodore stops in fog, watches Luma's reaction — recognition, alarm, scanner sweeping. Folklore becomes fact: the Tall Ones ARE the Titans. Close-up: Theodore wide-eyed and steady, three light sources converge, gran's warning quoted: "The fog looks back." Walk home becomes urgent — Theodore's building emerges, lamp by door amber pool. Final wide: Theodore at his door, key in hand, looking back at empty fog-filled street. Nothing visible. The fog has a watchful quality.
